meta.name: seo-geo
meta.description: Optimize content for AI Overviews (formerly SGE), ChatGPT web search, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search experiences. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) analysis including brand mention signals, AI crawler accessibility, llms.txt compliance, passage-level citability scoring, and platform-specific optimization. Use when user says "AI Overviews", "SGE", "GEO", "AI search", "LLM optimization", "Perplexity", "AI citations", "ChatGPT search", or "AI visibility".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化内容以适配AI搜索和概览结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的网站内容需要在ChatGPT、Perplexity等AI搜索中脱颖而出
copy.tagline_en: Optimize content for AI-powered search and overviews
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website content needs to stand out in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI search engines

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你给的网页，生成一份 GEO 优化报告，包括可引用性评分、AI 爬虫访问状态、品牌提及分析等，并给出具体改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI Overviews”、“GEO”、“AI 搜索”等关键词时，或者直接给出一个网址要求分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个网页的 AI 搜索可见性：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会生成一份完整的 GEO 分析报告。

say.text: 检查一下我的 robots.txt 是否允许 AI 爬虫访问。
这个页面在 ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 上的引用情况如何？
say.note: Claude 会进行平台特定的优化分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes a given URL and generates a GEO optimization report including citability scoring, AI crawler access status, brand mention analysis, and specific improvement suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "AI Overviews", "GEO", "AI search", etc., or when you provide a URL for analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze this page for AI search visibility: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full GEO analysis report.

say_en.text: Check if my robots.txt allows AI crawlers.
say_en.note: Claude will read robots.txt and list allowed/blocked crawlers.

say_en.text: How does this page perform on ChatGPT and Perplexity?
say_en.note: Claude will perform platform-specific optimization analysis.
